source.book: Original kid paraphrases. Book 1 is Genesis 1-2. Book 2 is Genesis 6-9. Not a copyrighted Bible translation.
source.copyrightNote: Short original Tigrinya lines and English glosses for young children. Do not paste a published translation.
source.shape: Creation uses a weekday refrain. Sunday is the first day. Friday is the sixth day, when the people are made. Saturday is the seventh-day rest. Tuesday, the third day, has two pages: land and sea, then grass and trees. Noah uses the same short repeated sentence shape, eight beats from Genesis 6-9.
source.orthographyNote: God's name is እግዚኣብሄር with ሄ, the spelling in ትመ15 (YouVersion Bible 2998). Noah is ኖህ in that same text (ህ, not ሕ). The ark is መርከብ, the dove is ርግቢ, and the olive leaf keeps ቘፅሊ ኣውሊዕ. Rain keeps the pack word ዝናብ; ትመ15 writes ዝናም and the verb ዘነመ. The bow is ቀስቲ, matching the app, though ትመ15 also writes ቐስቲ. Trees in Creation follow ኣእዋም. Grass keeps ሳዕሪ. Good stays ጽቡቕ; ትመ15 writes ፅቡቕ.
source.unlockNote: In the Beginning is the free taste. It opens before any School Path unit is finished. Noah's Ark is not free: it uses the ordinary band-1 progress gate (learned the 8th family), the same gate the Amharic band-1 library uses. It does not change the Creation unlock, the School Path unlocks, or the Amharic tracks.
source.artNote: God is not drawn. Each painting shows the thing that page names, in highland Horn light. People wear sand, linen, or sage. The flood stays gentle.

pages.meaningEn: On Sunday God made the light.
pages.pictureHint: Highland dawn, gold light breaking over dry ridges, no sun disk yet, no people

pages.meaningEn: On Monday God made the sky.
pages.pictureHint: A vast highland blue sky, a few high clouds, only a thin escarpment

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ምድሪን ባሕሪን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus midrin bahrin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the land and the sea.
pages.pictureHint: Ochre highland hills meeting a clear turquoise Red Sea, no people, no boats

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሰሉስ ሳዕሪን ኣእዋምን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet selus sarin aawamin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Tuesday God made the grass and the trees.
pages.pictureHint: Short highland grass, a baobab and acacias, plants only

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ረቡዕ ጸሓይን ወርሒን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet rebu tsehayin werhin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Wednesday God made the sun and the moon.
pages.pictureHint: Highland sky with a large warm sun and a large silver moon

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ሓሙስ ኣዕዋፍን ዓሳን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet hamus aawafin asan fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Thursday God made the birds and the fish.
pages.pictureHint: Horn birds in a highland sky and large friendly fish in clear sea water

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ዓርቢ ሰብኣይን ሰበይቲን ፈጠረ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet arbi sebayin sebeytin fetere.
pages.meaningEn: On Friday God made a man and a woman.
pages.pictureHint: A man and a woman with deep brown skin, modest long cotton clothes, standing by a baobab

pages.geez: እግዚኣብሄር ብዕለት ቀዳም ዓረፈ። ኩሉ ጽቡቕ።
pages.latin: Igziabher b-ilet qedam arefe. Kullu tsbuq.
pages.meaningEn: On Saturday God rested. Everything was good.
pages.pictureHint: Quiet highland evening, the same two people resting under a baobab, a goat lying down, sea still

question.meaningEn: What did God make on Friday?

pages.geez: ሰባት ጽቡቕ ኣይነበሩን። ኖህ ጽቡቕ ነበረ።
pages.latin: Sebat tsbuq ayneberun. Noh tsbuq nebere.
pages.meaningEn: People were not good. Noah was good.
pages.pictureHint: Noah calm in sand linen, a few people in sage and earth cloth turned away, no ark, no animals

pages.meaningEn: God told Noah to build an ark.
pages.pictureHint: Noah beside timber and a boat frame, looking up at an empty sky, no divine figure
Noah building a large wooden ark on dry highland ground, no animals, no rain

pages.geez: እንስሳታት ክልተ ክልተ ናብ መርከብ ኣተዉ።
pages.latin: Insisatat kilte kilte nab merkeb atewu.
pages.meaningEn: Animals went into the ark two by two.
pages.pictureHint: Calm pairs of goats, oxen, and doves walking into the ark, no people
Gentle rain over the ark on quiet water, no storm, no people
Calm water over highland hills, the ark floating safely, no people, no rainbow

pages.meaningEn: The dove brought an olive leaf.
pages.pictureHint: One dove with a green olive sprig in her beak, clearing sky, no rainbow
A soft rainbow over the quiet highland and the ark on the shore, no divine figure

question.meaningEn: What is there at the end?
